title: Surreal Montmartre Vision
description: A surreal painting of a Parisian cobblestone street lined with colorful buildings and shops leading toward the Sacré-Cœur Basilica under a bright sun. A large cracked female face with fiery hair and radiating pink beams emerges from the center of the street, towering over two small silhouetted figures.
prompt: Surreal painting of a sunny Montmartre street in Paris with colorful buildings, flower boxes, and a tree with orange flowers. A giant cracked porcelain-like female face with blue eyes and flaming golden hair emerges from the cobblestones, emitting bright pink energy beams. The Sacré-Cœur Basilica sits in the background under a radiant sun. Two small dark figures walk toward the face on the cracked pavement, vibrant Fauvist color palette with strong outlines.
